objective.name: world.get_order
objective.description: Look up an order of the shop by its identifier (status, carrier, delivery estimate, items, total).

#root.role: Return the order record for the given order identifier.

transformation_contract.morphing: An order identifier becomes the order record held by the shop.
invariants: The lookup is case-insensitive on the identifier.
An unknown identifier fails with a not-found error instead of returning an empty record.
success: The response carries the order with status, carrier, items and total_eur, and eta or delivered_on when applicable.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper over a fixed in-memory shop world (test infrastructure, deterministic).
failure: order_id missing or order not found.

effects.tool_calls: Appends one entry to the tool_calls matter.
